scientific_integrity: Classical arithmetic renewal theorem credited as a standard lemma; direct sources credited. Finite checker supplements but does not replace analytical proof; publication priority and broader overlap require independent review.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional unitary gate; full reset; independent identical positive integer intervals of finite mean; ensemble matrices, not pathwise convergence. Results about broader non-Markovian/partial resets and rates are not asserted.
title: An arithmetic-renewal dichotomy for quantum resetting: exact limit cycles and a no-cancellation criterion
